protocol.matching: One-to-one max TP then minimum circular error
protocol.recall_main: Includes every frame including empty output
protocol.mae: Only correctly matched TP directions within 15 degrees
protocol.reference_activity: All declared reference sources assumed active in every frame; no frame voice-activity ground truth
protocol.percentile_band: P10–P90 across target-angle geometries, not confidence intervals or independently repeated recordings
protocol.bootstrap: Fresh 2000 geometry-cluster bootstrap draws on reduced data; old full-data CIs not reused
